sanguinenetworks_sync_dedup.conversion: Mixin @Redirect of the ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket.create(this) call in VSBlockEntity.getUpdatePacket + MixinExtras @ModifyReturnValue on getUpdateTag(Provider) (Sanguine Neural Networks 1.21.1-2.0.1): null while the values of the update tag equal those of the last packet sent (numbers, altar, ItemStack.matches against copies of the sent slots, the same component map) and no different state was handed out since; NeoForge persistent data, data attachments and subclasses run the mod's method; every client holds the same state as without it. Trade-off (off by default): packets identical to the previous one are not sent, but each packet that does go out costs the server a few comparisons and two stack copies more than with the mod's own class. Runtime flag sanguinenetworksSyncDedup, shadow sanguinenetworksSyncDedup.shadow. Helper bons.furious.patch.sanguinenetworks_coo49.SacrificerSync.
